title: A T-cell-based immunogenicity protocol for evaluating human antigen-specific responses
protocol: Cryopreserve PBMCs.
Prepare cryopreservation solution containing 90% human serum and 10% DMSO.
Suspend isolated PBMCs at 5–25 million/mL concentration in cryopreservation solution.
Aliquot 1 mL of suspended PBMCs into cryovials.
Place cryovials into a cell freezing container, such as Mr. Frosty, and store at −80°C for 24–48 h.
Transfer cryovials into liquid nitrogen for long term storage.
Thaw cryopreserved PBMCs.
Remove cryovials containing cryopreserved PBMCs from liquid nitrogen storage.
Immediately place cryovials into 37°C water bath.
Remove vials from the water bath as soon as cells are almost thawed (typically <1 min) with a small pellet remaining.
Spray the outside of the vials with 70% ethanol.
Transfer the vials into a biological safety cabinet.
Treat thawed cells with DNase I.
Add 25 μL of DNase I stock solution into 24 mL X-VIVO 15 media to obtain a final 1 μg/mL concentration (approximately 2 U/mL).
Dilute 1 mL of thawed cells drop by drop into 24 mL X-VIVO 15 media containing DNase I.
Resuspend PBMCs at a concentration of 10^6 cells/mL in X-VIVO 15.
Centrifuge diluted cells at 400×g for 10 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend cells in 5 mL X-VIVO 15 media.
Pass the resuspended cells through a 70 μm cell strainer.
Take an aliquot and count the total number of cells.
Adjust the volume of X-VIVO 15 media to obtain a concentration of 10^6 cells/mL.
Transfer 100 μL of the resuspended cells per well into 96-well U bottom plates to seed 10^5 cells/well.
Prepare 2× cytokine solution.
Transfer 100 μL of the 2× cytokine solution into wells containing 100 μL of cells.
Mix gently by pipetting.
Incubate cells for 24 hours at a humidified incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Transfer the plates into a biological safety cabinet.
Remove 100 μL of solution from each well.
Add 100 μL of 2× adjuvant solution into appropriate wells to obtain a final concentration of 10 μM R848, 100 ng/mL LPS, and 10 ng/mL IL-1β.
Calculate the total volume of 2× adjuvant solution needed based on your plate design.
Prepare 2× adjuvant solution and divide it into separate tubes for each condition being tested.
Add peptides and vehicle control to each tube.
Mix well by pipetting gently.
Culture cells for 24 hours at a humidified incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Do not centrifuge the plates as cells will settle at the bottom following the 24 h incubation.
Be gentle while removing media at Step 8.b. and do not disturb the cell pellet.
Avoid disturbing the cell suspension during media exchanges to prevent cell loss.
Transfer the plates into a biological safety cabinet.
Remove 100 μl of solution from each well.
Add 100 μl of 2× feeding solution to obtain a final concentration of 10 IU/mL IL-2, 10 ng/mL IL-7, and 10 ng/mL IL-15.
Mix gently by pipetting.
Culture cells for 48–72 h at a humidified incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Harvest cells.
Label tubes with the names of each test condition.
Transfer the plates into a biological safety cabinet.
Mix the contents of each well vigorously by pipetting.
Collect and transfer the contents of wells into appropriate tubes.
Combine all replicate wells for each test condition.
Centrifuge cells at 400×g for 8 min.
Aspirate supernatant from cells.
Resuspend cells in R10 media.
Take an aliquot of resuspended cells and count the number of cells.
Adjust volume of R10 media to obtain a cell concentration of 2×106 cells/mL.
Transfer 100 μL of cells per well into a new 96-well U bottom plate in triplicates for each test group.
Calculate total volume of 2× re-stimulation solution needed based on plate design with extra amount to account for volume loss during transfer.
Prepare 2× re-stimulation solution.
Divide 2× re-stimulation solution into separate tubes for each test condition.
Add peptides and control reagents into each tube appropriately.
Mix well in each tube.
Add 100 μL of 2× re-stimulation solution supplemented with peptides or control reagents onto appropriate wells containing cells.
Mix by pipetting.
Culture cells for 1 h at a humidified incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Prepare 11× protein transport inhibition solution.
Add 20 μL of the protein transport inhibition solution into each well.
Mix by pipetting.
Culture cells for 8 h at a humidified incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Perform pilot experiments to determine the optimal incubation time following peptide stimulation.
Utilize tetramer staining if minimal epitope and restricting MHC information are known, skipping re-stimulation steps in this case.
Mix pelleted cells by pipetting and transfer to V bottom 96-well plates.
Centrifuge plates at 400×g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Rapidly decant the supernatant by inverting the plates over a waste container.
Gently tap the plates on a paper towel to remove excess fluid.
Stain cells for viability and extracellular markers.
Prepare the extracellular staining solution.
Calculate the total volume of solution required including an extra amount to account for volume loss during transfer.
Aliquot the determined volume of PBS.
Add antibodies, anti-CD3, anti-CD4, and anti-CD8 at 1:200 dilution to obtain a final concentration of 1 μg/mL, 0.4 μg/mL, and 0.25 μg/mL, respectively.
Add viability dye at 1:1000 dilution.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL extracellular staining solution.
Mix well by pipetting.
Incubate at 4°C for 20 min protected from light.
Wash cells.
Add 150 μL of PBS into each well.
Centrifuge plates at 400×g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Rapidly decant the supernatant by inverting the plates over a waste container.
Gently tap the plates on a paper towel to remove excess fluid.
Fix and permeabilize the cells.
Add 100 μL of Fixation/Permeabilization solution into each well.
Mix well by pipetting.
Incubate at 4°C for 30 min protected from light.
Wash cells.
Add 150 μL of 1× Perm/Wash Buffer into each well.
Centrifuge plates at 400×g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Rapidly decant the supernatant by inverting the plates over a waste container.
Gently tap the plates on a paper towel to remove excess fluid.
Prepare the intracellular staining solution.
Calculate the total volume of solution required including an extra amount to account for volume loss during transfer.
Aliquot the determined volume of 1× Perm/Wash Buffer.
Add antibodies, anti-IFN-γ, anti-TNF-α, and anti-IL-2 at 1:200 dilution to obtain a final concentration of 0.25 μg/mL, 1 μg/mL, and 0.15 μg/mL, respectively.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL intracellular staining solution.
Mix well by pipetting.
Incubate at 4°C for 30 min protected from light.
Wash cells.
Add 150 μL of 1× Perm/Wash Buffer into each well.
Centrifuge plates at 400×g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Rapidly decant the supernatant by inverting the plates over a waste container.
Gently tap the plates on a paper towel to remove excess fluid.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL PBS.
Store cells at 4°C protected from light until ready to acquire by flow cytometer.
Prepare single color compensation controls.
Label separate test tubes for each antibody used in staining for flow cytometry.
Vigorously vortex the beads.
Combine 1 drop of beads, 200 μL PBS, and 1 μL antibody in a test tube.
Mix and incubate at 4°C protected from light for 15–30 minutes.
Add 1 mL of PBS and centrifuge tubes at 400×g for 5 minutes.
Decant the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 250 μL PBS.
Store cells at 4°C protected from light until ready to acquire by flow cytometer.
Acquire and record data from experimental samples using a multi-color flow cytometer following fluorescence detector voltage and compensation setup.
Use compatible software, such as FlowJo, to analyze flow data.
